top_signals.title: Oaktree + IDF $1.7B project finance stack for Bloom/Nebius
top_signals.summary: First institutional-grade EaaS project finance structure disclosed. Morgan Stanley sole tax equity (ITC 48E), MUFG Bank senior debt, Oaktree minority equity. Blended WACC ~7-9%. IDF/Bloom portfolio >$2.6B. BE fell 13.64% on same day despite announcement.

top_signals.title: BE crashes to $206.73 (-13.64%) — below WF $217 bear case, 41% below June ATH
top_signals.summary: Bloom Energy first close below Wells Fargo $217 EW bear-case floor. Combined short-seller pressure (Hunterbrook, Crossroads, Doomberg), Project Jupiter permit uncertainty. Q2 earnings July 28 AH is reset catalyst (11 days). July 17 intraday ~$210.

top_signals.title: Mico Power (Korea) secures full European CE certification for 2 kW direct-hydrogen SOFC
top_signals.summary: First Korean commercial SOFC with full CE (GAR, LVD, EMC, ErP, factory inspection). A+ ErP rating. Meritz Securities ~$30M investment (March 2026). Plans: EU demonstration projects, SOEC, ammonia ship fuel cells.
